content.content: A marker file that cannot be read as a valid marker file refuses the invocation, naming the corruption.
content.rationale: Reading a torn file as empty would silently discard the bracketed history with no repair story. Refusing names the cause, and deleting the file recovers through missing-is-empty. A file that parses but does not conform to the marker schema is the same case — its contents are not a marker file — and refuses the same way.
